definitions.explanation: Becoming a member of a club, organization, association, or similar group. Refers to the act of formally signing up.

examples.japanese: スポーツクラブに{入会|にゅうかい}した。
{入会|にゅうかい}{金|きん}は{無料|むりょう}です。
{入会|にゅうかい}のお{申|もう}し{込|こ}みはウェブサイトから{受|う}け{付|つ}けております。
examples.english: Membership applications are accepted through the website.

notes:
Used for formal membership in organizations, clubs, gyms, associations, etc. Not used for casual groups or informal gatherings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{入会|にゅうかい}{金|きん} (enrollment fee, joining fee)
・{入会|にゅうかい}{手続|てつづ}き (membership procedures)
・{入会|にゅうかい}{申|もう}し{込|こ}み (membership application)
・{入会|にゅうかい}{資格|しかく} (membership eligibility)
・{入会|にゅうかい}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む (apply for membership)

ANTONYM:
・{退会|たいかい}: withdrawing from membership, leaving an organization
